summary: The Outer Fracture Belt is the unstable frontier of the Riftlands, where dimensional shockwaves from Discord-Core first tore open the landscape. Rifts erupt spontaneously, Void winds scour the terrain, and Riftseekers maintain fragile anchorpoints.
history: Formed when Discord-Core’s First Fracture sent shockwaves outward.
Terrain collapsed into jagged crackfields and floating shards.
Void winds began sweeping across the steppe, carrying corruption.
Riftseekers established anchorpoints to stabilize travel routes.
Muramite scouts attempted to seize the region but failed due to instability.
